entries.title: John 14:1
segments: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.

entries.title: John 14:2
segments: In my Father's house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

entries.title: John 14:3
segments: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, [there] ye may be also.

entries.title: John 14:4
segments: And whither I go, ye know the way.

entries.title: John 14:5
segments: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?

entries.title: John 14:6
segments: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.

entries.title: John 14:7
segments: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

entries.title: John 14:8
segments: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

entries.title: John 14:9
segments: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

entries.title: John 14:10
segments: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.

entries.title: John 14:11
segments: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

entries.title: John 14:12
segments: Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater [works] than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.

entries.title: John 14:13
segments: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

entries.title: John 14:14
segments: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.

entries.title: John 14:15
segments: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.

entries.title: John 14:16
segments: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

entries.title: John 14:17
segments: [even] the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.

entries.title: John 14:18
segments: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.

entries.title: John 14:19
segments: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.

entries.title: John 14:20
segments: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

entries.title: John 14:21
segments: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.

entries.title: John 14:22
segments: Judas (not Iscariot) saith unto him, Lord, what is come to pass that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

entries.title: John 14:23
segments: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

entries.title: John 14:24
segments: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

entries.title: John 14:25
segments: These things have I spoken unto you, while [yet] abiding with you.

entries.title: John 14:26
segments: But the Comforter, [even] the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.

entries.title: John 14:27
segments: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

entries.title: John 14:28
segments: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

entries.title: John 14:29
segments: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.

entries.title: John 14:30
segments: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;

entries.title: John 14:31
segments: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
